module: Flowgraph node "Get Button" (once_instant category): reads the state of a button created with Create Button. Input "buttonId". Outputs: "clicked" (impulse on click), "used" / "unused" (already clicked or not, hidden; old names complete/incomplete), "label", "active", "order", "style" (hidden).
notes: Bug: the 'unused' line reads self.pinOut.complete.value, but the pin is named 'used' in pinSchema (complete only exists in legacyPins); depending on how legacyPins are handled this can yield nil.
Category once_instant: workOnce reads the state only once; to watch a click continuously, use Get Multiple Buttons or Simple Button instead.

workOnce.desc: Gets the button by id and copies clicked, used, unused, label, active, order, style to the output pins.
